source: FAO-56 Table 19 (sandy loam: θFC 0.18–0.28, θWP 0.06–0.16; midpoints)
note: Farmer-described 'sandy' soils in India are mostly sandy loam; pure sand (θFC 0.07–0.17) would hold less.
